title: Walt Disney's E.P.C.O.T film (1966)
summary: The 1966 film Walt Disney recorded weeks before his death, laying out his plans for the Florida Project and especially EPCOT, a planned city of the future. It uses models, concept art and animation to describe the circular city, monorails and people movers.
why: HN cites it in discussions of planned cities and urban design as the original source for Disney's utopian EPCOT vision.

quote.text: The full EPCOT plans are interesting.
